comment: eat.c use_tin_opener() 3110-3113: a Priest knows the bless/curse state of every object, so a wished cursed tin opener applied while unwielded asks ynq("Really wield ...?"), whose default is q (hack.h 1330). The first apply answers ESC (the default); the second answers y, which welds the opener and goes on to getobj() and start_tin(). Seed, date and character chosen independently of batch 17.
